scope: Phase 17: PTT wire evidence and removal of actual leading digital-zero TTS padding. Overall semantic/RPC/device acceptance remains incomplete.

changes.benchmark: PTT min_user_finals uses distinct agent ptt.turn_status committed receipts with nonempty preview and turn ID; streaming still requires STT finals. No fake transcript events or lowered cardinality. Preview is capped at 80 chars by existing protocol.
changes.production: Bailian TTS reuses its decoded 60 ms AudioByteStream frames and existing output-byte count. Skip whole zero frames only before first output. Preserve the full first nonzero frame, +/-1 PCM samples and every subsequent pause. Same handling for final partial flush. Byte counter now counts bytes rather than int16 elements.
changes.unchanged: PTT release, half-duplex no barge-in, channel full-duplex ownership, EOT threshold/timeouts, intent default, framework APIs and dependencies.

verification.count_note: TTS scope includes pipeline/test_tts_stage.py, also included in core. Do not sum these groups without deduplication. Prior non-integration scenario suite was not rerun this phase.

environment_retry: Initial core run had 19 PermissionError failures when sandbox prevented temporary local test socket binding. Same full suite rerun with socket permission: 1007 pass, 11 existing xfail, 2 skip.
